At each iteration:

- From each row in the matrix, select the largest number and remove it. (So for each row, we remove its max element.)
- Among those selected numbers, find the highest number. Add that number to score.
- Continue with updated matrix (each row has one element removed; rows may become empty and thus removed from further operations when no elements left). Equivalent to performing per column of sorted rows.

Equivalent to for each iteration j (starting from 0), we consider column j of sorted rows (i.e., the j-th largest element from each row). Then the max among these column elements is added to score. Continue until any row runs out of elements. Since rows may have different lengths; we can only continue while all rows have at least one element left.
